messages:
alex: Quick check — vendor says there's a 48h grace window for held slots after we signal a soft-reserve. Do we treat those as reserved for tenant provisioning or free to allocate?
procurement-bot: FYI: vendor policy: `soft_hold` = 48h hold, then released unless a formal PO is submitted. See https://vendor.example/hold-policy :information_source:
priya: If it's released after 48h we risk demo owners not getting their tenants up for scheduled demos. We were planning automatic provisioning into the reserved pool.
tom: What's the current reserved pool size vs requested short-term bump? I can update the autoscaler if we get a +10 slot temporary.
alex: Current reserved pool = 30 slots (a100 mix). Demo schedule needs 40 next week. So we need +10 until EOD next Thursday.
sarah: @luis do we have quota headroom in eu-west to take an extra 10? Billing/commit implications?
luis: Short answer: maybe. We have 6 spare in eu-west, 8 in us-west. Vendor can ship across regions but cross-region latency for tenants is... suboptimal. If we want 10 in eu-west we need a temporary quota bump request to cloud account.
priya: Can we ask vendor to extend the soft_hold by another 48h while we process quota bump? That buys time. Who owns the PO? @alex or @sarah?
alex: I can file the PO but need procurement sign-off. I'll open procurement ticket now.
procurement-bot: New ticket created: PROC-5421. Attach vendor quote and desired dates. (Remind: attach signed SOW for >30 day holds) :page_with_curl:
priya: Meanwhile, can eng-infra change provisioning to favor demo-tenants into mixed pool (us-west fallback) automatically? A small change in TF should do it.
tom: I can push a tiny fallback rule in the provisioner. Example snippet:```
# provisioner snippet
module "tenant_provision" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/internal/provisioner.git//modules/demo"
  preferred_region = "eu-west"
  fallback_region  = "us-west"
  fallback_window  = 300 # seconds
}
```
I will open a PR and tag @priya for review.
sarah: Sounds good. Alex — when you create PROC-5421, add exact dates and mark as "temporary bump" so finance doesn't lock into a commit.
alex: Done. PROC-5421 now has dates 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-08 and note "temp bump for demo fleet". Tagging @luis for quota request.
luis: I'll submit cloud quota request now (REQ-9982). If vendor can extend soft_hold another 48h, we should be covered while cloud authorizes the bump.
procurement-bot: Vendor confirmed grace extension request received. ETA 4-6 hours for vendor confirm.
priya: Thanks all. I'll land the provisioner PR as draft and add the fallback switch behind a config flag so we can rollback fast.
tom: PR: https://git.internal/r/provisioner/pulls/412 — draft done, tagging for @priya review.
alex: Update: vendor confirmed extension for +48h. Procurement proceeding. If quota request hits delays, we flip the fallback flag and route demos to us-west as stopgap. :white_check_mark:
sarah: Can someone post the final plan in the demo-runbook (short steps and who to ping)? I'll link from the calendar invite.
priya: I'll update the runbook and paste link here when done.
alex: Closing loop — ticket PROC-5421 status: pending vendor SOW, REQ-9982 submitted, provisioner PR in draft. Will follow up in morning if anything blocks. :eyes:
